title: National Investment Manufacturing Zones
definition: National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZs) are mega-scale integrated industrial townships established under the National Policy on Manufacturing (NPM), 2011, designed to promote world-class infrastructure, clean technologies, and administrative ease for manufacturing growth.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy - Industrial Growth, Manufacturing Sector, Make in India, Infrastructure, Employment Generation) and Prelims (Policy provisions, minimum land area requirements, institutional mechanisms).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Investment Manufacturing Zones.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of industrial policy, SEZs vs NIMZs distinction, land acquisition laws
